rubrics.justification: Description is largely consistent with a high-quality expanded/hatching blastocyst, with appropriate comments on ICM, TE, and thinned zona; minor overstatement and some reliance on the provided Gardner grade rather than strictly image-only findings.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF history, sperm parameters, endometrium, and diagnosis well with embryo quality, though some claims are slightly optimistic and not all interactions are deeply nuanced.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with conclusions generally supported by the case details; however, the implantation estimate is somewhat optimistic and a few statements are stronger than the evidence supports.

Mostly consistent with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including SET/luteal support concepts; slight deviations include overconfidence in prognosis and limited nuance around assisted hatching/PGT-A indications.
Provides practical next steps such as proceeding with transfer, luteal support, and counseling, but recommendations remain fairly generic and the future-planning section is incomplete/truncated.
